text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since Inari One<n>began training
at Tracen, and every<n>day I'm stunned to see just
how<n>much she's grown since the last.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Howzat for speed, Boss? Another<n>record crushed
to bits!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Howzat for speed, Boss? Another<n>record crushed
to bits!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All we did was add a teensy bit more<n>weight to my
gym routine, and I'm<n>already seein' gains... Hehe,
aren't I<n>amazin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And when I was runnin’, I felt like my<n>speed kinda
leveled off, but then I<n>remembered what you said
about<n>goin' too hard, too fast!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And when I was runnin’, I felt like my<n>speed kinda
leveled off, but then I<n>remembered what you said
about<n>goin' too hard, too fast!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sure 'nough, soon as I eased up on<n>the gas a bit,
everythin' just started<n>comin' together! You're a
genius,<n>Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha, c'mon, don't be so shy!Doesn't hurt to brag a little. When theweather's nice, ya say so, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I got my powerful run from Oi, and<n>now I'm refinin'
it here at Tracen...<n>Ahhh, I really got the best of both
worlds, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tracen really is a good opportunity for<n>her... But
none of it would have been<n>possible without her old
trainer<n>pushing her to accept my offer.
choice_data_list: How's the chief doing, by the way?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, my old teammates told me<n>he's doin' fine.
I haven't really<n>contacted him myself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I called him too much, he'd<n>probs just
say, "Ya already left the<n>nest, quit chirpin' in my
ear!" and<n>hang up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
He gave me the push I needed, so<n>now I gotta fly
on my own! And I'm<n>gonna soar as high as the
festival<n>fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: With that... I'm goin' for another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The training regime I've put together<n>is no walk in
the park. Yet no matter<n>what I throw at her, Inari One
takes it<n>on with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's taken a lot of<n>adjustment, but she
never says<n>anything even close to a complaint.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's when I remember something<n>she told me
before we started training<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Pretty sure ya already know this,<n>Boss, but I'm
serious about racin'.<n>No way I would come all the
way to<n>Tracen without a roarin' fire in my<n>heart.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Pretty sure ya already know this,<n>Boss, but I'm
serious about racin'.<n>No way I would come all the
way to<n>Tracen without a roarin' fire in my<n>heart.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want no<n>lukewarm trainin'!
Throw caution to<n>the wind and throw all the gas ya
got<n>on this fire!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Inari One doesn't hesitate. She<n>charges in full
speed ahead, her<n>banner flyin' high!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series... Winnin' big<n>there will turn me
into a REAL<n>sensation!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, Inari One has been<n>working hard
to prepare for her debut,<n>and it shows. However...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew... Ehehe,how'dja like that, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew... Ehehe,how'dja like that, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes worry that I might be<n>overworking her.
But I know if I ever<n>asked...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! Not like I did<n>anythin' special
anyways.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She'd just flash me a big old smile<n>before telling
me she can easily<n>handle whatever I throw at her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Wazzup, Boss? Ya got one<n>serious look on
your fa—
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I scouted you!
I'm so glad I scouted you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Wazzup, Boss? Ya got one<n>serious look on
your fa—
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I scouted you!
I'm so glad I scouted you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to betray Inari One's<n>trust in me. I
don't want her to regret<n>coming all this way.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her work so hard, I silently<n>swear to turn
Inari One into a racing<n>sensation worthy of the
biggest<n>fireworks display ever created.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, where'd that come from?! Ya<n>sure know
how to put a smile on my<n>face!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But I getcha! Don't worry, once I'm<n>through, all of
Japan will be lookin' to<n>you for scoutin' advice!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But I getcha! Don't worry, once I'm<n>through, all of
Japan will be lookin' to<n>you for scoutin' advice!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She gives me a few enthusiastic pats<n>on the back,
and I feel some of that<n>energy of hers transfer to
me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Glad ya scouted me, huh? Ya<n>got high
hopes... or maybe ya just<n>trust me? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(No doubt about it, I'm stronger than<n>before... And
I'm sure soon enough,<n>I'll be stronger still.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I promise, Chief, my old team... and<n>even you, Boss!
I'm gonna run faster<n>and further than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I promise, Chief, my old team... and<n>even you, Boss!
I'm gonna run faster<n>and further than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep runnin' and runnin'... And if<n>anythin' gets
in my way, I'll blow it to<n>pieces!
